# Amazon Bedrock AgentCore data plane

Invoke AgentCore agent runtimes in Docker containers, one per runtime session, and store short-term memory events with expiry.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| Contract | Current implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `bedrockagentcore` |
| Signing name | `bedrock-agentcore` |
| Wire protocol | REST JSON |
| API version | `2024-02-28` |
| Scope | Account and region |
| Execution | Records events / optional Docker runtimes |
| Selected operations | 8 of 67 in the pinned model |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#amazon-bedrock-agentcore-data-plane) for this service's capabilities.

Set `bedrockagentcore.runtimes: docker` to run sessions in containers; the default `records` mode rejects InvokeAgentRuntime with ValidationException. See [Amazon Bedrock AgentCore](../guides/bedrock-agentcore.md) and [configuration](../getting-started/configuration.md#agentcore-runtime-execution).

## Limitations and future work

- Records mode (the default) cannot run an agent: InvokeAgentRuntime fails with ValidationException, the error shape CodeBuild's StartBuild uses, because no response would be an agent's. StopRuntimeSession then finds no session and answers ResourceNotFoundException.
- AWS runs each session in its own microVM; TinyStack runs a container. Images must be arm64 (or run emulated, which is slow on x86_64 hosts) and must already be local or pullable by the Docker daemon, including public.ecr.aws references; TinyStack's ECR is not consulted. Session state, MMDS and filesystem mounts are not emulated.
- A session keeps the version it started on until it ends. Calls do not carry the customJWTAuthorizer or the request header allowlist, and a bearer-token request cannot reach this service; GetAgentCard, InvokeAgentRuntimeCommand and AGUI are out of the profile.
- Containers reach TinyStack through host.docker.internal; on Linux, start TinyStack on an address the Docker bridge reaches. They sign with the creator's static credentials, not STS role credentials, as Lambda functions do, so the runtime's role is not assumed.
- Memory records, RetrieveMemoryRecords, extraction jobs, IngestData and the batch record operations are out of the profile because a memory has no strategies; extractionConfig on CreateEvent is not supported and extractionMode only accepts SKIP, which holds trivially.
- Event timestamps order events, so an event created with an earlier timestamp lists first; ListSessions reports a session's first event creation time and a session disappears with its last event rather than after the one day AWS keeps empty sessions.
- Tokens, expiry indexes and sessions are in TinyStack: the sweepers visit once a second and the container sessions are not recovered after a restart.
- Resource-based policies are out of the profile, so invoking another account's runtime fails with AccessDeniedException.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.

## Supported operations

The table is generated from the profile and pinned Smithy model. Routes show REST bindings or the standard
JSON/Query endpoint. RPC v2 CBOR uses its service/operation route, as described in
[protocol handling](../architecture/request-flow.md). Supported members are selected separately in the
[shape whitelist](https://github.com/amjadjibon/tinystack/blob/main/generator/model/profile.json); an enabled operation may reject unsupported options.

| Operation | HTTP binding |
| --- | --- |
| `CreateEvent` | `POST /memories/{memoryId}/events` |
| `DeleteEvent` | `DELETE /memories/{memoryId}/actor/{actorId}/sessions/{sessionId}/events/{eventId}` |
| `GetEvent` | `GET /memories/{memoryId}/actor/{actorId}/sessions/{sessionId}/events/{eventId}` |
| `InvokeAgentRuntime` | `POST /runtimes/{agentRuntimeArn}/invocations` |
| `ListActors` | `POST /memories/{memoryId}/actors` |
| `ListEvents` | `POST /memories/{memoryId}/actor/{actorId}/sessions/{sessionId}` |
| `ListSessions` | `POST /memories/{memoryId}/actor/{actorId}/sessions` |
| `StopRuntimeSession` | `POST /runtimes/{agentRuntimeArn}/stopruntimesession` |
